name: Huber+Suhner AG
summary: Huber+Suhner AG engages in the provision of power and data connectivity components and system solutions in Switzerland, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. It operates through three segments: Industry, Communication, and Transportation.
